replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
2 months. Started with the flu, then turned into pneumonia/delirium, then back to the flu. It wasn't fun. =/

EDIT: I lied, it started with the 'Common Cold', then turned into the flu. Once I got the flu a second time, it started to calm down and go into the Cold again, but the Cold symptoms only lasted about 4-5 days. It was close to 2 months and 1 week.

replies.author: TheColdCrafter
replies.body:
Yeah its ross river
Ross River virus (RRV) is a small encapsulated single-strand RNA alphavirusendemic to Australia, Papua New Guinea and other islands in the South Pacific. It is responsible for a type of mosquito-borne non-lethal but debilitating tropical diseaseknown as Ross River fever, previously termed "epidemic polyarthritis". The virus is suspected to be enzootic in populations of various native Australian mammals, and has been found on occasion in horses.[1]rRoss River virus (RRV) is a small encapsulated single-strand RNA alphavirusendemic to Australia, Papua New Guinea and other islands in the South Pacific.
